source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
Sugarcane mosaic virus (ជម្ងឺវីងស្លឹក, Sugarcane Mosaic Virus): this disease is transmitted by an insect vector named Cicadullina spp. This disease commonly occurs during one particular season, especially in fields located near sugarcane fields, since the disease is also spread by thrips and hoppers. Symptoms show yellow-orange striping along the leaf, resembling a chlorotic/mottled leaf pattern; the disease can spread rapidly and severely during a plant's growth stage as it develops.

This disease has no specific chemical cure; recommended measures include:
- Select and plant clean seed with no history of the disease.
- Use resistant/tolerant varieties.
- Sanitize field tools appropriately.
- Plant at an appropriate time to avoid periods of high vector risk.
